crossRefs.note: You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.
He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,
that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise Yah!
He struck many nations, and killed mighty kings,
and killed mighty kings; for his loving kindness endures forever:
Now Jericho was tightly shut up because of the children of Israel. No one went out, and no one came in.
Moreover you gave them kingdoms and peoples, which you allotted according to their portions. So they possessed the land…
You shall inherit the land by lot according to your families; to the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to…
Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh.”
These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of…
It shall be, when Yahweh your God brings you into the land which he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
translations.bsb: He drove out nations before them and apportioned their inheritance; He settled the tribes of Israel in their tents.
translations.kjv: He cast out the heathen also before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
translations.asv: He drove out the nations also before them, And allotted them for an inheritance by line, And made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
